results.title: Europe’s heavy rare earth opportunity
results.snippet: On 9 November, China extended its pause on the wider rare earth export controls it announced in October 2025 until 10 January 2027. Many headlines read this as relief. However, the pause has never covered the licensing regime China introduced in April 2025 on seven medium and heavy rare earths, including dysprosium, terbium and yttrium. Every export of those still requires a licence from Beijing.
